#!/bin/bash
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export HF_HUB_CACHE=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export MUJOCO_GL=egl
export PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=egl
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

echo "=== Starting baseline_std eval ==="
echo "Model: lerobot/smolvla_libero"
echo "GPU: cuda:0"
echo "Time: $(date)"

cd /root/acib

for SUITE in libero_spatial libero_object libero_goal libero_10; do
    echo ""
    echo "=== Suite: $SUITE ==="
    echo "Start: $(date)"
    lerobot-eval \
        --policy.path=lerobot/smolvla_libero \
        --env.type=libero \
        --env.task=$SUITE \
        --eval.n_episodes=50 \
        --eval.batch_size=1 \
        --output_dir=/root/acib/outputs/baseline_std/$SUITE \
        2>&1 | tee /root/acib/outputs/baseline_std/${SUITE}.log
    echo "End: $(date)"
done

echo ""
echo "=== ALL SUITES DONE ==="
echo "Time: $(date)"
EOF
chmod +x /root/acib/scripts/run_eval_std.sh
echo "DONE: run_eval_std.sh"

cat > /tmp/auto_launch_eval.sh << 'BASHEOF'
#!/bin/bash
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

# Wait for download process to finish
while kill -0 28824 2>/dev/null; do
    sleep 30
    echo "$(date): Waiting for downloads (PID 28824)..."
    du -sh /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/models--lerobot--smolvla_libero/ /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/models--lerobot--smolvla_libero_plus/ 2>/dev/null
done

echo "$(date): Downloads complete! Verifying..."

# Verify models
export HF_HUB_CACHE=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
python3 -c "
from huggingface_hub import try_to_load_from_cache
import os
os.environ['HF_HUB_CACHE'] = '/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache'
p1 = try_to_load_from_cache('lerobot/smolvla_libero', 'config.json')
p2 = try_to_load_from_cache('lerobot/smolvla_libero_plus', 'config.json')
print(f'smolvla_libero: {\"OK\" if p1 else \"MISSING\"}')
print(f'smolvla_libero_plus: {\"OK\" if p2 else \"MISSING\"}')
"

echo "$(date): Launching eval jobs..."

# Launch std eval on GPU 0
nohup bash /root/acib/scripts/run_eval_std.sh > /root/acib/outputs/baseline_std/main.log 2>&1 &
echo "STD_PID=$!"

# Launch plus eval on GPU 1
nohup bash /root/acib/scripts/run_eval_plus.sh > /root/acib/outputs/baseline_plus/main.log 2>&1 &
echo "PLUS_PID=$!"

echo "$(date): Both evals launched!"
BASHEOF
chmod +x /tmp/auto_launch_eval.sh
nohup bash /tmp/auto_launch_eval.sh > /tmp/auto_launch.log 2>&1 &
echo "AUTO_LAUNCH_PID=$!"
